system_prompt_style.note: No prompt-construction code in bundle; docs/ENGINE_CONTEXT_ASSEMBLY_MAP.md referenced but not included.

env_context_strategy.note: README mentions runtime retrieval, repo intelligence and GraphRAG docs, but the default context config and tool list are not in the bundle.

tool_call_format.note: Tests mention a 'model tool schema', but no parser code in bundle.

edit_primitive.note: Edit tool definitions not in bundle.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Tandem can connect to MCP servers, sync tools, and scope selected connector tools to workflow nodes.
tool_schema_source.note: Built-in tool schema source unknown (code not in bundle); only the MCP source is recorded.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Tandem can connect to MCP servers, sync tools, and scope selected connector tools to workflow nodes.
protocol_standardization.note: Also exposes its own MCP interface for external agents.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Workflows and automations compile into task graphs with dependencies, gates, outputs, validation, and ownership.
loop_primitives.note: Based on prose only. The session engine loop is assumed to be react; event_driven is based on the SSE event streams. Plan Mode is also offered (plan_execute is possible).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Runs, tasks, blackboards, checkpoints, artifacts, validations, approvals, receipts, and replayable events live in durable engine state.
planning_granularity.note: Supported by the Plan Preview/Apply and plan compiler.

multi_agent_topology.note: Default session is a single agent. Kanban multi-agent orchestration is available; the topology is unclear from prose.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Agents claim tasks, report blockers, and hand off work through deterministic state.
delegation_mechanism.note: Default session is assumed to have no delegation. Multi-agent kanban hand-off via shared state (closest: message_bus) is reachable.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Write/delete operations require approval via supervised tool flow
human_in_loop.note: Approval gates offer approve/rework/cancel options; policy is scoped per workflow step.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Runs AI workflows with durable state instead of transcript-only execution.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Vector-backed session, project, global, and file-import memory paths carry tenant scope.
long_term_memory.note: Skill library is supported by the SKILL.md packs in agent-templates.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Every meaningful run has a durable identity that can be inspected, resumed, retried, and debugged.

self_verification.note: Artifact 'validation' is mentioned, but the mechanism is not shown.

retry_policy.note: Runs can be 'retried', but no policy is shown.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Single-user desktop runtime with local workspace scope, provider setup, and approval-gated tools.
execution_isolation.note: Local sidecar on the host is the default. Docker setup exists via a separate tandem-agents repo; hosted mode is also available.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Filesystem safety**: Access is scoped to granted folders; sensitive paths are denied by default.

network_policy.note: No execution network config in bundle.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Blocks tool calls that fall outside runtime policy before execution.
permission_model.note: Also requires per-call approval for write/delete operations.

tracing.evidence_quote: Canonical event schema, durable replay log, and tenant-scoped query contract.

replayability.evidence_quote: How to turn live workflow failures into deterministic replay regressions and release gates.
replayability.note: Deterministic replay uses a mock provider; not claimed as a general guarantee.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Long-session context regression evals with provenance assertions.
eval_hooks.note: Supported by the eval-regression-gate workflow; not a benchmark evaluation.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Blocks tool calls that fall outside runtime policy before execution.
guardrails.note: Redactions are mentioned in the ACME receipt, so output_filters is possible.

target_domain.evidence_quote: files, repositories, email, MCP tools, customer data, internal docs, production workflows, and long-running automations.

open_source.evidence_quote: the engine server, mission/plan compiler, recursive governance engine, incident monitor, and enterprise server are source-available under Business Source License terms.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Use OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenCode Zen, or local Ollama endpoints.

first_release_date.note: No first tag date in the evidence.

stars.note: No star count in the evidence.
